data.title: [Treasury Spend] Allocate ION incentives to the ION DAO dev contributors
data.description:
## Summary
By voting YES on this proposal, ION stakers voice their support for executing a transaction to allocate 3,407.04 ION (16% of the total supply) to the dev contributors’ wallet osmo1g6cjx9fju0le5ptx70rwrucj9qqngv39rzu8rk over a period of 60 months.

By voting NO on this proposal, ION stakers voice their dissent in executing a transaction to allocate 3,407.04 ION (16% of the total supply) to the dev contributors’ wallet osmo1g6cjx9fju0le5ptx70rwrucj9qqngv39rzu8rk over a period of 60 months.

## Background
The [Commonwealth proposal on launching the ION DAO testnet](https://commonwealth.im/ion/discussion/4778-introducing-ion-dao-public-testnet-phase) uploaded in May 2022 marked the beginning of the ION DAO dev contributors’ involvement as the main dev contributors of one of the oldest, most active DAOs in the Cosmos ecosystem. As soon as we were offered the opportunity, we gladly took on the role and have diligently been working on building real use cases of ION and imbuing life into the community revolving around the mysterious meme token of Osmosis. Here’s what ION DAO has achieved in the last 12 months under our initiatives:  
- ION DAO smart contracts deployment & frontend UI
  - Website ([https://ion.wtf]([https://ion.wtf))
  - Staking and Governance features
  - Minor updates in UI/UX based on the requests from the community/partners
- ION DAO governance ([ION CommonWealth](https://commonwealth.im/ion/discussions) / [ION Governance](https://ion.wtf/governance))
  - 5 passed
  - 1 rejected
  - 15 drafts uploaded on ION Commonwealth
- Osmosis governance
  - 8 passed
  - 1 rejected
  - 7 drafts uploaded on Osmosis CommonWealth
- IBCX (Successfully launched 8 months after the first announcement to the community)
  - Beta test launches and operation (two tests 
successfully executed)
  - Smart contracts preparation & [audit](https://github.com/oak-security/audit-reports/blob/master/IBCX/2023-04-29%20Audit%20Report%20-%20IBCX%20v1.0.pdf) by [OakSecurity](https://www.oaksecurity.io/)
  - Smart contracts deployment & frontend UI
  - Landing page with Mint, Burn, and My Page features
  - Launched on May 18th, 2023
  - TVL $120,000 with a month
- stIBCX (Collaboration with the Stride team; the first liquid staked index token in Cosmos)

The ION DAO dev contributors are a team of nine builders who successfully delivered the above milestones and are dedicated to continuing to shape the future of ION DAO. Our team’s been working together since 2021 with the goal of expediting the proliferation of the Cosmos ecosystem and eventually the mass adoption of blockchain technology, having participated in various projects including single-handedly revamping the Keplr wallet’s web/mobile Dashboard in Q3/Q4 2022. Here’s our lineup:
- 2 Contract engineers
- 1 Back-end engineer
- 2 Front-end engineers
- 1 Product manager
- 1 UI/UX Designer
- 1 Community manager
- 1 Operations/finance manager

The ION DAO was initiated and established by Manythings, but has not been managed under the name of Manythings entity. The ION DAO dev contributors, a group including several members from Manythings, have been working for ION DAO with the budget funded by Manythings.
## Dev Funding Proposal
The rationale behind this funding proposal is for our team to procure the necessary funding required to cover our operational costs and align long-term incentives with ION DAO for which we have firm dedication and love.

In the last 12 months, we incurred ~$576,000 in expenses building for ION DAO:
- Payroll: $480,000 ($40,000/month)
- Infrastructure (node operation and other server-related costs): $96,000 ($8,000/month)
- Excludes other miscellaneous expenses such as rent and SG&A

As widely known within the community, our team has been self-funding and developing without any compensation for our contributions. While we are more than happy to have had the opportunity to lead the development of ION DAO in such a manner, it is an undeniable fact that we find it increasingly challenging to sustain operations purely out of pocket. Therefore, we would like to propose the following dev funding scheme to the ION DAO community:
- Total allocation amount: 3,407.04 ION (16.00% of total)
- Duration of allocation: 60 months (starting from this proposal’s passing)
- Vesting method: Linear (similar to how [Sablier](https://sablier.finance/) operates; implied monthly allocation of 56.78 ION)

We’re fully aware of the significance of the amount that we’re asking. Here are our rationales behind the proposed allocation scheme:
1. Main purpose: To sustain the team and keep our builders motivated 
   - Over the 60-month period, 75% of the funding received will be used to help maintain our team (salaries and other HR related costs), while the remaining 25% will be reserved as extra reward incentives for our team members who make significant long-term contributions. 
2. NOT our purpose: Creating strong sell pressure on ION
   - We’re fully aware of the fact that ION is still a token that’s just begun its journey and thus has relatively low liquidity on the market. As a significant owner of the ION tokens, we’ll naturally not be incentivized to do actions that will negatively impact the token’s performance and wholesomeness. Again, as the first dedicated dev contributors of ION DAO, we’re in for the long haul and truly desire the community to thrive and participants to benefit. We believe that our such intent and level of dedication were proven by the previous 12 months of pouring in our abilities and labor in planning, design, and development to increase the potential value of ION. We see this 5-year funding plan as a crucial measure to further gear our vision towards enhancing the ION ecosystem and its liquidity.
3. Drive further value creation and accumulation in ION DAO
   - The funding plan will motivate our team not only as the ION recipients but also as the ION builders. All products and applications launched by the DAO will be structured to funnel their incurred operational value into the ION token. This essentially means that the dev contributors now gain the direct financial incentives to build and launch quality products in a timely manner, strive to execute marketing and operational plans with best possible results, and ensure the longevity and continued value accrual of the services.
   - For example, the success of ION DAO’s first product, IBCX, directly leads to value accretion of ION since the index portfolio contains ION. Additionally, 70% of both fee revenues (management and burn fees) get directly accumulated to the ION DAO Treasury, the amount which can be utilized in efforts to further drive the value of the ION token in the future.

## What We Have in Store for ION DAO
We have lots of ideas and plans for ION DAO, and IBCX will be in the driver’s seat. Ultimately, our goal is to make IBCX the backbone of Cosmos DeFi, augmented by liquid staking powered by Stride. For shorter-term goals, let us share our 2023 roadmap:

**Q3 2023**
- Whitelist the support of IBCX/stIBCX on Keplr (Mobile/Extension) - **Completed**
- Add ION DAO website on the Keplr Mobile - **Completed**
- Enable Superfluid Staking for ION/OSMO Liquidity Pool #1013 - **Completed**
- Migrate OSMO incentives from ION/OSMO Liquidity Pool #2 to ION/OSMO Liquidity Pool #1013 - **Work in progress**
- Establish marketing subDAO - **Work in progress**
- Rebalancing #1 - **Work in progress**
- Improve ION DAO and IBCX dApp UI/UX - **Work in progress**
- Reward governance participants - **Work in progress**
- Revamp ION DAO website
- Launch a separate ION DAO Rebalancing UI
- IBCX website upgrades
  - Stats feature
  - stIBCX transaction history - **Completed**
- Launch the Auto-Order feature powered by Calculated Finance
- ION DAO dApp Leap integration (Mobile)
- IBCX dApp Leap integration (PC, Mobile)
- Add ION incentives to IBCX/OSMO liquidity pool and stIBCX/OSMO liquidity pool

**2023 Q4**
- ION airdrop (details to be shared and proposed to the community beforehand)
- Enable fiat on-ramp on the IBCX website powered by Kado
- Enable cross-chain Minting of IBCX and stIBCX powered by Squid SDK
- Launch IBCX/stIBCX as collateral on Mars
- Launch vault strategy on Mars powered by Apollo DAO
- Implement ION staking rewards

## Conclusion
The ION DAO dev contributors pride themselves on taking on the role of developing for the coolest DAO in the Cosmos ecosystem. We firmly believe that the funding plan we hereby propose will further strengthen our incentive alignment with ION DAO, and we think it’ll ultimately result in more quality applications and services that’ll drive ION’s value in the future. As always, your opinions and suggestions on our proposal will be greatly appreciated.
